title: Derive behaviour from the exact normalized XDL graph
statement: The X-Verse platform must derive the activation plan from the exact normalized XDL graph without a competing configuration language, and equivalent normalized inputs must derive one canonical representation.
applicability: X-Verse capability 007 phase 4 derived activation plan; verified for the bounded T020 slice only.
verification_intent: Realized for the T020 test slice by T020-SR-001; whole-system exercised by the assembled-candidate integration measure.
acceptance_criteria: The derived artifact is a function of the normalized graph only.
No second configuration language or competing topology is introduced by the T020 slice.
Equivalent normalized inputs derive byte-identical canonical plan bodies.
